=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py` lines 531-537 (_env_positive_float), consumed at line 285 in check_pr | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: _env_positive_float parses float values from environment variables and checks only value > 0. For strings representing infinity such as "inf", "+inf", or overflowed exponential floats like "1e309", float() returns math.inf. Because inf > 0 evaluates to True, the function returns inf instead of falling back to default.
  WHY: When CLAUDE_FIX_HOLD_MAX_HOURS is configured to "inf" or "1e309", hold_max_hours is set to infinity. The comparison hold_age_hours < hold_max_hours evaluates to True for any finite hold age, silently bypassing the 24-hour limit introduced in issue #5927 and leaving a held PR in state: held indefinitely. Additionally, callers converting the return value of _env_positive_float to integer (such as cap = int(_env_positive_float("CLAUDE_FIX_HAND_BACK_CAP", ...)) at line 584) will raise an unhandled OverflowError.
- `docs/implement-plan/issue-5927-bound-plain-mode-hold.md` lines 7, 10, 17, and 24 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The progress log records "Status: BLOCKED", "Waiting on: PR #5944: twin sync (review round 1)", and leaves checklist item 24 unchecked, even though commit 31b27bc376eb ("[claude-twin-sync] issue-5927 phase 1 review round 1 check_in_status.py") has already copied the twin into .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py.
  WHY: Per .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:17-18 and 302, the /implement-plan-claude orchestration automation inspects the progress log's Status and Waiting on fields as the authoritative source of truth. Because the log indicates the project is blocked waiting on a twin sync that has already landed, stage resumption checks or supervisory routines reading this file will halt waiting on an already-completed prerequisite, stalling the project chain.
- `docs/implement-plan/issue-5927-bound-plain-mode-hold.md` line 21 vs line 45 (AD-8) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Phase 1 Docs checklist item at line 21 is marked complete and asserts that "the #5667 fragment's 'What outranks a hold' row" was updated. However, auto-decision AD-8 on line 45 explicitly records that this edit was reverted during review round 1 to satisfy CLAUDE.md §20.B.
  WHY: The progress checklist directly contradicts both AD-8 and the actual diff where changelog.d/5667-checker-waits-on-held-head.md is untouched. Resumed stage sessions and conformance audits checking checklist completion against the git diff encounter an inconsistent project record.
- `tests/test_check_in_status.py` lines 1105-1113 (test_invalid_hold_limit_falls_back_to_24_hours) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test parametrizes only bad_limit values in ["0", "-1", "abc", ""], omitting non-finite float representations such as "inf", "+inf", or overflowed exponential floats like "1e309".
  WHY: Because non-finite float inputs are not tested against the fallback logic, the test suite passes green even though setting CLAUDE_FIX_HOLD_MAX_HOURS=inf allows inf to pass through _env_positive_float and disable the hold age limit, masking the bypass in CI.
